hero.lead: Freedom requires responsibility. Success requires solidarity. What I observe daily in my work: economy and society are not opposites – they depend on each other.

band: Solidary liberalism · Economy as a tool of society · Dialogue instead of polarisation

haltung.label: Stance
haltung.h2: A new balance between economy, state and society.
haltung.lead: The old ideological camps are reaching their limits. We need a model that builds bridges instead of trenches.

p1.p: Companies should develop freely – with the readiness to bear social responsibility. Not as a constraint, but as an attitude.

p2.p: The state sets fair rules and invests where markets fail. It enables – it does not direct.

p3.p: Economic success is not an end in itself. It should provide people with security, opportunities and quality of life.

antreibt.label: What drives me
antreibt.quote: "Those who take responsibility deserve freedom. Those who only optimise contribute to social erosion."
antreibt.p: I am an SP member – and yet I believe in economic freedom. I experience this apparent contradiction every day: in consultations, in advocacy, in contact with startups and politics. The answer lies not in ideology, but in dialogue.

b1.p: As a neuropsychologist I have learned: behind every position lies a need. Whoever understands the person can talk to them – even if you don't share the same opinion. This principle shapes how I conduct conversations and how I assess political positions.

b2.p: Five years of data science at the anti-money laundering reporting office taught me one thing: good decisions need evidence, not ideology. Sometimes 'not yet decided' is the most precise answer – and that is not a weakness.

b3.p: As an SP member I experience daily that the fundamental needs of all parties are more similar than the rhetoric suggests. The difference lies not in the what, but in the how. I look for the common denominator – not as a compromise, but as a starting point.

b4.h3: Talking is good. Building is better.
b4.p: With Sublingua and Fizzi & the Prof! I am building things I would have needed myself: rethinking learning, making knowledge accessible. Convictions you don't act on are merely opinions.

k1.p: Dialogue before polarisation. Economy in service of society. Responsibility instead of ideology.

k2.p: Trust is built through conscious communication – not by chance.

k3.p: Rethinking education – with neuropsychology, animation and genuine joy of learning.
